title: A novel tetranuclear Cu(ii) complex for DNA-binding and in vitro anticancer activity.
authors: Cao, Shuhua; Wang, Anlin; Li, Kaoxue; Lin, Zhiteng; Yang, Hongwei; Zhang, Xiaolei; Qiu, Jianmei; Tai, Xishi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究四核铜配合物与DNA的嵌入结合及抗癌活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系中的DNA结合与分子对接，但对象为小分子配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法以实验为主、分子对接仅辅助，与TF-DNA结合机制建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: A novel tetranuclear Cu(ii) complex (TNC) was successfully synthesized and characterized by X-ray single crystal diffraction. The interaction of the complex with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) has been studied by UV-vis absorption titration, fluorescence technology and molecular docking. The results indicated that TNC could bind to the DNA through an intercalative mode. The agarose gel electrophoresis experiment showed that TNC could cleave supercoiled plasmid DNA into linear DNA. The anticancer activity of TNC was tested on four cancer cell lines: MCF7, A549, 4T1 and HepG2. The results indicated that TNC shown significant activity against all of above cell lines.
abstract_zh: 成功合成了一种新型四核铜(II)配合物（TNC），并通过X射线单晶衍射进行了表征。通过紫外-可见吸收滴定、荧光技术和分子对接研究了该配合物与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的相互作用。结果表明，TNC能够以嵌入模式与DNA结合。琼脂糖凝胶电泳实验显示，TNC能将超螺旋质粒DNA切割为线性DNA。在四种癌细胞系（MCF7、A549、4T1和HepG2）上测试了TNC的抗癌活性。结果表明，TNC对上述所有细胞系均表现出显著活性。
